title: 1994 Comic Images Brothers Hildebrandt #20 Inside the Great Temple of Isis Card
condition_description: Near mint or better. See photos.
description:
1994 Comic Images The Brothers Hildebrandt collector card #20, "Inside the Great Temple of Isis" - Egyptian Sands subset (card 1 of 6). Painted by Greg and Tim Hildebrandt in 1993 for the hidden-image puzzle book In Search of King Tut's Tomb.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.

Card Name: Inside the Great Temple of Isis
